18.caption_en: All four players are in proper position for the serve. Player A serves tightly to C’s backhand.

20.caption_en: Player A has served to the backhand of C, who returns crosscourt out of reach of the offensive netman and follows his return to the net. A, moving in quickly behind his service, prepares to volley the shoulder- high forehand. B and D  altered their basic positions when C returned service.

21.caption_en: Player A closes in on the return and volleys down the middle for a winner. B moves toward the net. C and D are trapped. iT  —— A and B form the base of the triangle. The ball is the third point.

24.caption_en: Player A moves into perfect position in preparation for the return of service.  B and D move with the volley.

25.caption_en: Player A, attacking, gets to the ball before it can drop and volleys crosscourt in front of C for the winner. B moves over to guard the alley. Note that A and B finish the point in the triangle, side by side.

26.caption_en: C has placed a medium-paced return crosscourt, and A stoops to pick up the volley with his forehand. C is coming in behind his return, and B will begin his move toward the center of the court.

27.caption_en: Player A picks up the volley and sends it down the alley for the winner. D is too late. C is out of play. A and B will follow behind the volley, ending the point side by side with A near the alley and B just across the center line. I]

28.caption_en: C lobs over A’s head as A comes in behind his serve. B starts back to join his partner as C and D move toward the net.

29.caption_en: Player A goes up for the overhead as B sets up the base of the triangle by his side. They will come to the net behind the smash. D  is in the best defensive position, but C is trapped on the service line as the ball goes between them for a winner. i)

32.caption_en: C returns the serve down the middle. A corrects his direction and moves toward the ball. B moves toward center court as D anticipates the volley and moves in to intercept.

33.caption_en: Player A closes quickly and volleys the backhand down the middle in front of D, finishing the point side by side with B in the best court position, the triangle. 17

34.caption_en: C hits  a medium-paced crosscourt return and follows in along the path of the ball. A prepares for the volley. B steps toward center court as D moves in. Note how A gets in low to volley.

35.caption_en: A hits a soft drop shot crosscourt into the alley. B moves over to cover any possible return.  C and D change direction, with C heading for the ball and D covering center court. A is following behind his shot and will be in the triangle when the point ends. 19

42.caption_en: ‘ | | | | C tries the middle of the court on the return of serve, but B steps in quickly to cut it off. Player A continues toward the net. C follows in behind his return as D moves in. oe  see.  |

43.caption_en: B volleys the ball sharply, angling it into the alley for a winner. Player A will finish the point near B. C and D have no chance for a play on the ball. 27

44.caption_en: C returns service down the middle where B  is waiting to knock it off.  B steps in and angles the ball in front of D. Player A sees where the shot is going and heads for the alley.

46.caption_en: Player B goes back for the lob as C and D close on the net. A stops his forward motion and Starts back to join his partner.

47.caption_en: B smashes the overhead between C and D  for the winner. A and B follow in behind the shot. Note how player B keeps his head up and his eyes on the ball as he hits the overhead. 31

50.caption_en: B has been waiting all day for this one. C returns the serve high down the middle, directly at B. Player A continues toward the net. D starts toward the center of the court.

51.caption_en: in 8 a B steps in and drops the ball just over the net into the alley. A keeps coming and will be next to B at the net, in preparation for a possible return. A’s preparation is important, especially after the chancy drop shot. 30

56.caption_en: me Player A takes the return of serve well out in front but is forced to volley from below the net. C is closing quickly after his return. B and D  alter their positions slightly as the play develops.

57.caption_en: _-—-—> C hits down the middle with a perfect forehand drive volley. D moves in to complete the triangle. 41

58.caption_en: Player A lifts the return of serve up from the service line as C and D close in for the volley.

59.caption_en: C volleys behind A as A moves to cover the middle. C and D are in the triangle and in the best offensive position. 43

62.caption_en: A volleys the return of serve low from midcourt as C and D take advantage of the low return to rush the net.

63.caption_en: C moves in and takes the high volley early, angling it in front of B for a winner. Note that when a player is forced to hit the ball up, his opponent has the opportunity to hit it down. 47

64.caption_en: B lines up the service return lob as C and D take an offensive net position. A backpedals to join B.

65.caption_en: C anticipates the smash and cuts off the ball with a sharply angled backhand volley in front of A. A and B are left of the baseline. C and D follow the volley and set up the triangle. 49

68.caption_en: Player A serves to C, who takes it on the rise as D starts to move toward the middle of the court. ove ae Oe  tO  ait —+

69.caption_en: Getting into the shot, C drives the ball down the line for a winner. In case B can get his racket on it, D is moving to cover any possible return. Be)

74.caption_en: Player A half-volleys the excellent service return, popping it up over the center of the net.  B moves to close off the middle.

75.caption_en: D steps in quickly to volley down the middle for the winner. C is in good position and is prepared to volley with his backhand. 59

76.caption_en: Player A is forced to volley the return of service from near the service line. Since he hits from below the net, the ball gets up too high to be effective. - Se

77.caption_en: A and B move to guard the center. C continues to improve his position. D steps in and cuts off the volley, hitting a sharply angled crosscourt winner behind A. 61

80.caption_en: C’s return of service is picked up wide by A, who has come in smartly behind his serve. The alley looks open, so he goes for it.

81.caption_en: D moves in and drives the backhand volley between A and B for an outright winner, illustrating the point that you can get killed trying the netman’s alley. 65

82.caption_en: Player A decides to try it again. He lifts the return of service up and goes for the alley.

83.caption_en: —  ——  —  —  __.  __. __ > Sure enough, D steps across and nails the return down the line exactly as he should, while A and B close off the middle. C continues toward the net. 67

86.caption_en: _——_  > B moves back to take the service return lob. Player A backpedals to join B.  C and D rush to the net as B hits the overhead.

87.caption_en: As the ball clears the net, D attacks and volleys the return up the middle, directly between A and B. A and B  are in good defensive positions. C and D set up the triangle. fa
